title: Let Xcode finish preparing the iPhone (the phone test can't connect)
instructions: On the Mac, open Xcode > Window > Devices and Simulators and select the iPhone. Keep the phone unlocked and plugged in until the iPhone shows no error or 'preparing' message (a few minutes), then press Done; if it shows an error, type it in the notes.
